label: visual-only
vendored_note: Nothing was downloaded, vendored or executed. The research candidates were considered and not adopted (see considered_not_adopted); the bake uses published formulas, constants already in this repository and its own deterministic noise.

generated.note: the PNG's bytes depend on the zlib build; the pixels' own hash is top_relief.rgba_sha256 in alpine_fog.json and is what the test rebuilds

sources.name: Koschmieder 1924, Theorie der horizontalen Sichtweite: visibility = 3.912 / extinction (2 % contrast threshold)
sources.used_for: visibility column of alpine_fog.json; the same constant as core/scene/weather_visuals.py fog_extinction_per_m

sources.name: Bohren 1987, Multiple scattering of light and some of its observable consequences, Am. J. Phys. 55, 524: two-stream reflectance of a non-absorbing layer, (1-g) tau / (2 + (1-g) tau)
sources.note: typed from memory, not fetched; the result is flagged UNCALIBRATED

sources.name: Hillaire 2020, A Scalable and Production Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique (EGSR 2020), table 1: Rayleigh scattering coefficients and scale height
sources.note: copied from that lane, not fetched

sources.name: This repository: core/scene/weather_visuals.py ENGINE_FOG_DENSITY_PER_EXTINCTION and FlightSimGoogleTiles.cpp FogColumnM (both read on the UE 5.7.4 sources by their authors)
sources.used_for: FogDensity and FogHeightFalloff from extinction and scale height

sources.name: This repository: swarm/lanes/lighting_exposure/physical_light_units/alpine/alpine_plu.json, rows at 1600 m and 3000 m, sun 30 deg
sources.used_for: nominal sun and sky illuminance at the fog top

considered_not_adopted.name: miepython (scottprahl), MIT
considered_not_adopted.reason: A droplet phase LUT has nowhere to be sampled in tiers 0-2: ExponentialHeightFog exposes one cosine-power lobe. Worth adopting if a later tier writes its own fog shader (fogbow, glory).

considered_not_adopted.name: Narasimhan and Nayar 2003, atmospheric point spread function (paper)
considered_not_adopted.reason: Glow around lights in fog; the alpine frame is a daylight frame with no light sources in the fog. Belongs to the night scenario.

considered_not_adopted.name: astra-vision/weather-particle-simulator, MIT / Apache-2.0
considered_not_adopted.reason: Rain and snow particle statistics, not fog; its Columbia streak database is unlicensed and stays rejected.
